content:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate + spike on /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1 edge). 5xxs and 429s increasing rapidly. Suspect scraper/credential-stuffing fanout. Paging oncall.

sammie.leung: I'm on it. seeing a traffic fanout from ~150 origin IPs hitting batch embeddings endpoint, sustained qps ~12k for last 6m.

rajiv.patel: Confirmed. 503s from model pool exhaustion + 429s at edge rate limiter. Per-tenant throttles triggered. Visibility: per-route tokens burned in <30s.

kevin.tan: Can we add a temporary stricter rate-slice for anonymous/unknown API keys at edge and raise quota for high-tier customers only? We should also enable stricter WAF signature set for the route.

alyssa.martin: Agreed. Proposal: 1) Apply adaptive WAF blocklist for requests with no user-agent/known UA patterns. 2) Reduce burst window for /v1/embeddings to 10r/s per IP. 3) Move heavy batch ingestion to a canary-off: disable batch endpoint in eu-west-1 (route -> 503 fallback) while keeping single-request path.

liz.huang: Thx. I'm preparing the edge change. Will push rate-limiter config and WAF rule.

ops-bot: Executing change: apply-rate-limit {"route":"/v1/embeddings","region":"eu-west-1","limit":"10r/s","burst":"20"} — queued

ops-bot: WAF update: enabling blocklist signatures 7,9,42 for path /v1/embeddings — queued

incident-bot: Note: enabling WAF may cause false positives. Watch the support queue for customer complaints.

rajiv.patel: I'll open a temporary canary disable for batch endpoint in eu-west-1: setting route tag batch_enabled=false for region eu-west-1. Customers will get 503 for batch calls; singles still pass. Good tradeoff to stop pool exhaustion.

kevin.tan: How many customers impacted by batch disable? we need to notify big ones.

alyssa.martin: Current metrics: 12 orgs using batch in eu-west-1, 3 orgs classified as enterprise (have failover to multi-region), 9 orgs will see degraded throughput. We should send an incident notice to those 9 and offer guidance to retry/backoff.

sammie.leung: Edge changes applied: rate-slice enabled and WAF rules in effect. Early telemetry: inbound qps dropped ~70% within 90s. Errors from scrapers dropping too.

ops-bot: Change: canary-disable batch endpoint in eu-west-1 -> applied. Route mapping updated to fallback 503.

liz.huang: Support note draft: "We are mitigating an elevated automated traffic surge in EU region affecting batched embeddings. We've temporarily disabled batched ingestion in eu-west-1 to preserve service for interactive requests. If you rely on batched ingest, please switch to single-request calls or route to another region. Expect full restore after traffic stabilizes." cc @support-team

rajiv.patel: Customer impact assessment: degraded throughput for 9 orgs, increased latency for 4 orgs that were hitting retries, but core interactive flows remain within SLA for 95% of customers. No data exfiltration signs.

kevin.tan: Will we need to escalate to legal/compliance? Looks like bot scraping, not credential stuffing. No successful auth bypasses, just heavy token reuse.

alyssa.martin: Not yet. Keep monitoring. If we see auth error spikes or account lockouts, escalate.

incident-bot: Oncall handoff in 45m to @sammie.leung -> @rajiv.patel for next shift. Add post-incident follow-up: audit WAF false positives, review rate-slice thresholds, run root-cause: identify upstream proxy farm.

sammie.leung: Quick note: I blacklisted top 20 offending IPs at edge, but they reappear via CDNs. Need signature-based WAF and token-reuse detection.

liz.huang: Opening a JIRA: INC-3765 with action items: postmortem, customer notifications, longer-term traffic-shaping policy.

kevin.tan: Also recommend adding a short-term quota top-up for affected enterprise customers while we keep batch paused, to minimize customer impact. Ops/finance approval?

alyssa.martin: I'll put together the customer credit proposal.

sammie.leung: Current status 15m after mitigations: 5xxs down 85%, overall qps normalized to baseline, support queue has 2 open tickets from affected customers (not critical). Holding actions for 30m then consider staged re-enable for batch with stricter per-tenant caps.

incident-bot: Resolved: mitigations active. Please update the incident channel if anything changes. Incident tag: live-mitigation/waf-rate-slice.
